Hi Troy and Ron,

Please coordinate directly with Tyson and the Onesta team to have the
necessary crew onsite Monday, October 26, and complete the remaining
Carney/Onesta work **no later than end of day Tuesday, October 27**.

These items have been raised repeatedly and remain outstanding. Based on our
earlier discussions, my understanding was that the remaining work required
approximately one to two days. We need this work completed now so it does not
cause further delays to inspections and opening.

Please confirm by **9:00 AM PT Monday** :

  1. Who will be onsite and when, including the electrician.
  2. The completion date for each outstanding item.
  3. Any specific blocker or information needed from me.

Please proceed with all work that does not depend on the landlord’s stair work
or inspection in parallel. If any item is at risk of missing Tuesday’s
deadline, please identify it immediately and explain how you will resolve the
issue.

I remain available to provide access or clarify any items promptly. My
priority is to finish the work and move forward with inspections and the CO.

Thank you,  
Bharath

Everett [WAS Re: CO]



Hi Everyone,

Following our recent walkthrough and discussions with the on-site
subcontractor, I want to consolidate the remaining punch list items into one
document so that everyone is aligned on what remains outstanding.

Our goal is to establish a final, mutually agreed-upon list of outstanding
items, avoid continued additions or revisions, and close out the project.

**Outstanding Items Requiring Resolution**

  1. **High-Low Water Fountain:** The fountain has been installed. [@Bharath Mysore](mailto:bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com) has indicated that additional covering is required. Bharath, please clarify exactly what is being requested.

  

  2. **Cabinet Installation:** The cabinet spec has been sent to subcontractor, [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com) you should have clarity on the specific locations and any installation requirements. Let us know if you have any questions:

  

Wall mount cabinets (goes to sink area) were at least 60inch length and
counter cabinets(in party room) we 90inch. Look at video for the explanation
in iSoE_Counter+LowerCabinets video and wall mount cabinets in pic

  

  3. **Cash Wrap:** The following items have been identified:  
  

     * Anchor the cash wrap to the floor, maintaining approximately 1 inch of clearance from the wall.
     * Provide an electrical receptacle for the equipment.
     * Create an opening for network cables to pass from the wall to the computers.
     * Install shelving for computers and supplies.

     * [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)I sent the video to accompany this explanation 

  

  4. **Sink and Mirror:** The owner has indicated that a two-bay sink with two faucets was expected rather than the installed three-bay sink with one faucet. The owner is awaiting dimensions of the replacement sink before purchasing the mirror. We need to confirm the previously agreed-upon specifications and associated installation requirements.

[@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)did you install the correct sink
per plans?

  

  5. **Electrical Outlets:** Investigate the reported power issue, including the outlet serving the paint gear TV. Any additional nonfunctioning outlets should be specifically identified.

  

  6. **Smash Room Light Covers:** Install the requested protective mesh covers over the ceiling light fixtures. Confirm the required locations and quantities.

  

  7. **Paint Room Switch Covers:** Install protective covers intended to prevent guests from accidentally turning off the lights. Confirm the required locations and quantities.

  

  8. **Storage Room Ceiling Repair:** Address the reported opening in the ceiling near the exit door, as identified in the owner’s photograph.

  9. [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com) when is the electrician moving the signs?

  10. [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)please send a schedule that explains when each final item will be completed. 

Please review the above and identify any discrepancies, missing details, or
items that have already been resolved.

Once everyone confirms this list, we will use it as the agreed-upon punch list
for project closeout. Any additional requests or modifications introduced
afterward will need to be reviewed separately to determine whether they
constitute outstanding contractual obligations or additional scope.

We want to get the remaining work completed as efficiently as possible, but we
also need to establish a defined scope so that the punch list does not
continue to evolve as we approach completion.

Please reply to this email with your confirmation or corrections so we can
finalize the list and coordinate the remaining work.

Thank you,

Troy Fink

405 Estates Ct.

Newtown, PA 18940

message.subject: Re: Next Steps — Revised Egress Plans and City CO for iSmash Everett [WAS Re: CO]

body.content:
Hi Troy and Ron,

Please coordinate directly with Tyson and the Onesta team to have the
necessary crew onsite Monday, October 26, and complete the remaining
Carney/Onesta work **no later than end of day Tuesday, October 27**.

These items have been raised repeatedly and remain outstanding. Based on our
earlier discussions, my understanding was that the remaining work required
approximately one to two days. We need this work completed now so it does not
cause further delays to inspections and opening.

Please confirm by **9:00 AM PT Monday** :

  1. Who will be onsite and when, including the electrician.
  2. The completion date for each outstanding item.
  3. Any specific blocker or information needed from me.

Please proceed with all work that does not depend on the landlord’s stair work
or inspection in parallel. If any item is at risk of missing Tuesday’s
deadline, please identify it immediately and explain how you will resolve the
issue.

I remain available to provide access or clarify any items promptly. My
priority is to finish the work and move forward with inspections and the CO.

Thank you,  
Bharath

  

  

* * *

**From:** Troy Fink <troy@carneycontracting.com>  
**Sent:** Friday, October 23, 2026 4:55 PM  
**To:** Bharath Mysore <bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com>; Ron Tobiasz
<ron@carneycontracting.com>  
**Cc:** Scott Laviano <slaviano@ismashfranchise.com>; Jeff Howe
<jeff@carneycontracting.com>; Michael Carney <mcarney@carneycontracting.com>;
iSmash Support <support@ismashfranchise.com>  
**Subject:** Re: Next Steps — Revised Egress Plans and City CO for iSmash
Everett [WAS Re: CO]



Hi Everyone,

Following our recent walkthrough and discussions with the on-site
subcontractor, I want to consolidate the remaining punch list items into one
document so that everyone is aligned on what remains outstanding.

Our goal is to establish a final, mutually agreed-upon list of outstanding
items, avoid continued additions or revisions, and close out the project.

**Outstanding Items Requiring Resolution**

  1. **High-Low Water Fountain:** The fountain has been installed. [@Bharath Mysore](mailto:bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com) has indicated that additional covering is required. Bharath, please clarify exactly what is being requested.

  

  2. **Cabinet Installation:** The cabinet spec has been sent to subcontractor, [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com) you should have clarity on the specific locations and any installation requirements. Let us know if you have any questions:

  

Wall mount cabinets (goes to sink area) were at least 60inch length and
counter cabinets(in party room) we 90inch. Look at video for the explanation
in iSoE_Counter+LowerCabinets video and wall mount cabinets in pic

  

  3. **Cash Wrap:** The following items have been identified:  
  

     * Anchor the cash wrap to the floor, maintaining approximately 1 inch of clearance from the wall.
     * Provide an electrical receptacle for the equipment.
     * Create an opening for network cables to pass from the wall to the computers.
     * Install shelving for computers and supplies.

     * [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)I sent the video to accompany this explanation 

  

  4. **Sink and Mirror:** The owner has indicated that a two-bay sink with two faucets was expected rather than the installed three-bay sink with one faucet. The owner is awaiting dimensions of the replacement sink before purchasing the mirror. We need to confirm the previously agreed-upon specifications and associated installation requirements.

[@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)did you install the correct sink
per plans?

  

  5. **Electrical Outlets:** Investigate the reported power issue, including the outlet serving the paint gear TV. Any additional nonfunctioning outlets should be specifically identified.

  

  6. **Smash Room Light Covers:** Install the requested protective mesh covers over the ceiling light fixtures. Confirm the required locations and quantities.

  

  7. **Paint Room Switch Covers:** Install protective covers intended to prevent guests from accidentally turning off the lights. Confirm the required locations and quantities.

  

  8. **Storage Room Ceiling Repair:** Address the reported opening in the ceiling near the exit door, as identified in the owner’s photograph.

  9. [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com) when is the electrician moving the signs?

  10. [@Tyson Ferreira](mailto:tyson@onestallc.com)please send a schedule that explains when each final item will be completed. 

Please review the above and identify any discrepancies, missing details, or
items that have already been resolved.

Once everyone confirms this list, we will use it as the agreed-upon punch list
for project closeout. Any additional requests or modifications introduced
afterward will need to be reviewed separately to determine whether they
constitute outstanding contractual obligations or additional scope.

We want to get the remaining work completed as efficiently as possible, but we
also need to establish a defined scope so that the punch list does not
continue to evolve as we approach completion.

Please reply to this email with your confirmation or corrections so we can
finalize the list and coordinate the remaining work.

Thank you,

Troy Fink

Client Relations

Carney Contracting Services, Inc.

405 Estates Ct.

Newtown, PA 18940

C: 215-906-3474

Hi Troy and Ron,
Please coordinate directly with Tyson and the Onesta team to have the necessary crew onsite Monday, October 26, and complete the remaining Carney/Onesta work no later than end of day Tuesday, October 27.
These items have been raised rep
message.display_title: Re: Next Steps — Revised Egress Plans and City CO for iSmash Everett [WAS Re: CO]

attachment_summary.note: All seven messages report has_attachments=false. Inline/remote images not separately retrieved. Earlier attachment-download gaps, including booking.ics, remain unchanged.

key_updates.summary: Owner sent the previously reviewed completion-request wording. Requested crew onsite Oct26, completion by Oct27 EOD, and crew/electrician/itemwise schedule/blockers by Oct26 9AM PT. This establishes that the request was sent, not that Carney accepted the deadline.

Ron writes 'We will give you an update.' He requests updates about landlord completion that night and asks for someone onsite to handle the inspection and answer stair questions. No crew/electrician attendance, itemwise dates, acceptance of Oct27 completion deadline or inspection booking supplied. No later substantive Carney schedule found through cutoff.

Four Quaint Oak notifications report $7,081.75 posted/withdrawn/debited via ACH from account ending1461 on Oct26. E006 description is 'SMASH DISTRICT L Thomas sig'. Same amount, account, transaction date and near-identical notification times suggest one transaction described by multiple alerts; do not sum four payments. Description suggests Thomas Sign, but final payee, purpose, invoice allocation and satisfaction of prior ACH-backup request are not independently verified.

Automated reminder for today's in-person Permit Services appointment, 2:20–2:35PM Pacific, 2930 Wetmore Ave Suite2. No meeting outcome, permission for early setup/inspection, inspection pass or CO in this message or newer searched email.

No new direct Alex, Troy, Onesta/Tyson or iSmash corporate email found. No landlord-work completion confirmation, passed-inspection report or issued CO. Local owner-reported revision-work authorization and half-day/couple-day duration estimates remain separately recorded and are not converted into verified email commitments.

financial_alert_grouping.qualification: Inference from shared amount/account/date/times; no unique bank transaction ID supplied. Preserve all original alerts; do not treat them as four separate payments.

limitations: Read-only Outlook access; no outbound messages, mailbox changes, payment actions, scheduling changes, signatures or deletions.
Absence statements refer to searched email only; not phone calls, texts, onsite facts or permit-portal status.
Domain-wide Quaint Oak search returned zero while recent-mail screening and exact alerts@quaintoak.com search found four notifications; broad screening was used as a cross-check.
Saved bodies are connector renderings, not original EML/MIME files.
Original unsent-draft review remains preserved with its historical status; E007 now separately documents actual sent email.
Revision authorization is not a CO; no legal conclusion or independent permit review performed.
